dogecoin.text:
Yo, crypto bros! Dogecoin's back, pumped by Elon's X dreams.  
Fartcoin's a billion-dollar joke - smell the scam!  
Vitalik's preaching AI-Web3 salvation, but memecoins still rule.  
Pump, dump, repeat - welcome to the wild west of DeFi! 🦍

Troller Cat up 1800% while Dogecoin naps?  
PepeDAO thinks it's DeFi's savior.  
Meanwhile, XRP dumps and kitties pump.  
Web3's wild, but scams hit harder than a k-pop rugpull.  
HODL or get rekt, degens.
